# Microsoft completes construction on first datacenter facility in Mount Pleasant, Wisconsin (Microsoft Source, 2026-06-23)

Primary announcement from Microsoft (news.microsoft.com/source).

## Key findings
- Microsoft completed construction of its **first datacenter facility in the Village of Mount Pleasant, Wisconsin** ("Fairwater"), bringing equipment online in April 2026; the facility is now **fully operational**.
- Brad Smith (Vice Chair & President, Microsoft): "With our Fairwater datacenter now fully operational, Wisconsin is now home to the **world's most powerful supercomputer**."
- Announced May 2024; completed ahead of schedule; ~550 full-time employees on-site at the first facility.
- Microsoft estimates **$4.7 billion** spent locally in Wisconsin on hyperscale construction 2024–2028.
- A **second facility** in Mount Pleasant (adjacent) is under construction, scheduled to complete in 2028.

## Assessment
- `authoritative: yes` — primary Microsoft announcement.
- Establishes **Microsoft Fairwater** as a major, operational US AI-infrastructure site in **Mount Pleasant, Wisconsin** (Racine County).
- The "~3.3 GW" campus figure is an **Epoch AI analyst projection** (peak load by late 2027), NOT a Microsoft-disclosed number; this source supports the site's existence, location, and operational status, not the 3.3 GW figure.
